Name: Oriental Rugs and Tatami Set
Author: SSaturn0601
Description:
[b][size=4][u][center]DESCRIPTION[/center][/u][/size][/b]
Mix and match your own tatami set to fit the design of your room, or decorate those boring floorboards with a decorative carpet!

This mod contains a total of 28 rugs:

- 3 2x2 tatami (baby blue, pastel pink, and basic brown)
- 3 4x2 tatami (baby blue, pastel pink, and basic brown)
- 4 2x1 mats
- 5 3x2 mats
- 5 3x3 rugs
- 4 4x3 carpets
- 1 4x4 Aladdin's Magic Carpet
- 3 4x4 round carpets
